banner: DEMONSTRATION — SYNTHETIC PATIENT DATA — NOT FOR CLINICAL USE
syntheticData: All patient data in this demo is synthetic.
resetConfirm: Reset all demo data on this device? This cannot be undone.
ruleDisclaimer: DEMO_RULE_NOT_CLINICALLY_VALIDATED — this flag comes from an illustrative demo rule. Its thresholds are placeholders and are not clinically validated.

SCN-01.title: Normal screening
SCN-01.description: A submitted screening by a worker at Demo Health Centre Alpha-1 that did not need clinician review.

SCN-02.title: Flagged screening
SCN-02.description: A screening flagged by the illustrative demo rule, with a pending review and a fully explained flag.

SCN-03.title: Clinician dismissal
SCN-03.description: A clinician dismissed a demo flag with a recorded reason; no referral was made.

SCN-04.title: Overdue referral
SCN-04.description: A scheduled referral whose due date has passed (demo timing).

SCN-05.title: Completed follow-up
SCN-05.description: A follow-up completed with evidence, with a care instruction released to the citizen.

SCN-06.title: Missing glucose unit
SCN-06.description: An imported screening and a worker draft where the glucose unit is missing.

SCN-07.title: Duplicate submission
SCN-07.description: The same offline submission queued twice with one idempotency key; only one record is kept.

SCN-08.title: Offline sync
SCN-08.description: Two screenings saved on the device while offline, waiting to sync.

SCN-09.title: Version conflict
SCN-09.description: A queued follow-up update made on an older version, which raises a conflict when synced.

SCN-10.title: Consent withdrawn
SCN-10.description: A citizen withdrew consent: reminders are cancelled and the wallet cannot open the record.

SCN-11.title: Unauthorised district access
SCN-11.description: A district analyst for Demo District Alpha tries to open Demo District Beta data and is denied.

SCN-12.title: Suppressed small aggregate
SCN-12.description: A Demo District Beta figure below the small-cell threshold is shown as suppressed.
